defensiveAbilities.name: Nourishing Aura
defensiveAbilities.description: 100 feet. Presulea can sense the presence of any living creature inside their nourishing aura. This functions as an imprecise sense. Any spells with the healing or vitality trait are automatically heightened one rank (up to rank 4) if the caster is within the aura. Presulea treats a creature that casts such a spell as though they can always see it for 1 hour following the casting, ignoring the effects of any cover, concealment, invisibility, or similar effects.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vital Siphon
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger A creature within their nourishing aura uses an effect with the healing trait

Effect Presulea siphons half the amount that would be healed (rounded down) to heal themself or an ally within their aura instead of the original target.

offensiveAbilities.name: Return to Aucturn
offensiveAbilities.description: Presulea teleports to the location of any aucturnite fragment within a planetary range. Presulea automatically uses this ability as a free action when reduced to 0 Hit Points as long as a piece of aucturnite is within range, reforming their body and recovering completely over the next 24 hours.

cantrips.name: Eldritch Lance
cantrips.description:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

cantrips.name: Reorient
cantrips.description: Applying a combination of vital energy and acupressure, you help the target regain its footing. The target loses the Off-Guard condition if it has it. The target becomes immune to the off-guard condition until the start of your next turn, even if the condition would be circumstantially applied, such as by being flanked or Prone. The target is then immune to reorient for 10 minutes.

lv1spells.name: Cellular Stimulant
lv1spells.targets: 1 willing living creature that isn't fatigued or quickened
lv1spells.description:
You vitalize and stimulate the target at a cellular level, giving it a temporary burst of energy that unfortunately takes an exhausting toll. The target gains the Quickened condition and can use the extra action to Stride or Strike. After that round ends, the target becomes Fatigued until it can rest for 10 minutes.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to six creatures by using 2 actions to Cast this Spell.

lv1spells.name: Heal
lv1spells.description:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

◆ The spell has a range of touch.

◆◆ (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

◆◆◆ (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a 30ft Emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

lv2spells.name: Soul Surge
lv2spells.description:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes Drained 1.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).

lv2spells.name: Verdant Code
lv2spells.targets: 1 unattended object with the tech trait
lv2spells.description: You cause flowering vines or other plant matter to grow from an unattended tech object. Plant matter explodes from the target object, filling all squares within a 20-foot burst. Whenever a creature starts its turn in the area, it takes 2d6 piercing damage (basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, the creature is Immobilized for 1 round or until it Escapes against your spell DC. The growth covers the object, requiring a creature to succeed at a Basic DC 5 Flat to physically access the object for the spell's duration.
